limitations: Source-only engineering review, not an F1/F2/F3 performance/integrity audit and not a model/M0 acceptance receipt.
No SSH, model or training-module import, GPU, optimizer, scorer/report invocation, deployment, deletion, or experiment-evidence mutation was performed by this reviewer.

Actual completed F3 audit/claim receipts and publication/synchronization remain prelaunch dependencies. The added direct audit read was inspected as source; no unfinished review was used as an accepted result.
Initial equality, eight-update support, BN counters, CUDA memory fit and strict reload must pass on the real nine M0s; no source argument substitutes for those results.
Disk figures are prior executor resource/binary-size receipts and estimates. New model checkpoint sizes and live resource availability remain runtime observations.

Single seed42, official-test best-epoch selection and extra native capacity limit later claims. A positive result is not capacity-independent evidence, training-seed significance, three-new-module success or SOTA.
